metaTitle: Neon Drift Arena · Free 4-player couch brawler in your browser
metaDescription: Four ships, one couch. Asteroids drift, a blaster that kicks back, phones as controllers. Free, no install, last ship flying wins.
tagline: Four ships. One couch. Asteroids drift, a blaster that kicks back, and a phone for whoever lost the pad war.
videoAlt: Thirty seconds of a four-ship match in Neon Drift Arena
p1: Two to four players on one couch, free for all or teams. Bots fill the empty seats, and anyone can drop in mid-match by pressing Start.
alt1: The whole arena: octagon border, boost pads, weapon crates and asteroid lanes
p2: Asteroids-style drift with no brakes. Every shot kicks you backwards, so the blaster doubles as your reverse thruster. Ram at speed and you both pay.
p3: Same physics, a circuit instead of an arena. Portals for checkpoints, kart-style grip in the corners, and weapons that stun instead of kill.
alt3: A lime ship charging the tractor beam while a railgun bolt crosses the arena
p4: Out of controllers? Scan the QR code in the lobby and a phone becomes one: a floating stick, fire, boost and special under your thumbs.
